premises.SNPR1_oriented_multiplicity_free_seed: the complete unital seven-role possibility grammar is generated by oriented primitive occurrences with v^2=0 and no additional relations
premises.SNPR2_positive_hodge_realization: the base supplies one positive K_* and realizes each typed role as epsilon(v)+iota_{K_*(v,-)} with no bypass
premises.SNPR3_binary_frobenius_record: one source-owned exchangeable binary Frobenius unfolding supplies two typed record ports and their symmetric pointed root
premises.SNPR4_full_source_naturality: the occupied source state is invariant under every within-block inner frame automorphism and the transitive grade/record block exchanges
premises.SNPR5_pointed_cyclic_occupation: the empty exterior word and symmetric record root are physically occupied, their vector state is the occupied state constrained by SNPR4, and their generated orbit is the complete required support

composition_theorem.name: SNPR-P1 source-natural pointed realization
chain: SNPR1 implies Lambda^bullet(C^7) with its empty-word root
SNPR2 implies typed CAR_7 and Cl_7(C)
SNPR5 plus the Hodge realization makes the root orbit the faithful trace-GNS packet
GNS faithfulness forces dimension 256 and word degree recovers N_ext
composition_theorem.conclusion: the complete P3 relation, symmetry, cyclic occupation, 256-dimensional carrier and Boolean/CAR_7 Hodge grammar follow jointly, up to typed unitary

independence_controls.without_SNPR1: tensor and symmetric seed grammars share the primitive inventory
independence_controls.without_SNPR2: an oriented word inventory need not carry the adjoint CAR realization
independence_controls.without_SNPR3: the Clifford packet has 128 rather than 256 algebra/GNS dimensions
independence_controls.without_SNPR4_inner_naturality: a faithful full-rank nontracial block density survives
independence_controls.without_SNPR4_block_exchange: unequal positive central block weights survive
independence_controls.without_SNPR5: a rootless or spectator-extended realization has the same algebraic relations but different occupation

source_freeze_payload.exact_remaining_physical_statement: the unrestricted physical base-seed parent realizes SNPR1--SNPR5; equivalently it owns the oriented multiplicity-free pointed seed, the positive no-bypass Hodge realization, the binary record unfolding and full source naturality on one occupied packet
